title: Someone’s In The Kitchen With DNA
description: Have you ever wondered why fat parents have fat children or why Chinese parents have Chinese children? It’s no coincidence. It’s because of DNA.
quote: DNA is God’s recipe for making you.
altHero: Troy McClure in a hazmat suit in a science lab
alt1: fat woman with a new baby in the hospital, her husband is eating a caramel apple and the baby is eating some pizza
alt2: Chinese couple with tons of Chinese kids
alt3: Troy McClure with a kid in the lab
alt4: Troy McClure with a chef hat that says “God”, mixing pink liquid in a beaker
